title: GuidanceRequest
description: Web service to agent service: one Patient turn of the Guidance flow (spec 01). Never logged or stored.

sessionId.description: Opaque session id, not linked to any account.

language.description: UI language from the toggle. The agent answers in the language of the complaint.

audio.description: Voice note of up to 60 seconds, forwarded to Gemini as native audio. Never stored.

dataBase64.description: Base64 of the recording. At most 2,800,000 characters (about 2 MB): 60 seconds of 16 kHz mono WAV, and well above 60 seconds of Opus or AAC.

followUpQuestion.description: The followUp question the previous response asked, echoed back with the answer so the agent sees what the answer replies to. Model text, not Patient text, but sent by the browser, so the agent treats it as data.

followUpAnswer.description: Answer to the one followUp question, if the previous response asked one.
